== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Removes owner's optional draw 1 from Reserve Deck when a character is placed here. Both still prevent opponent activation at your cloud sectors, lose prior occupant on replacement, and relocate to unoccupied Cloud City site in owner's control phase or place character in Used Pile.
